title: Be a licensed land valuer
what: Carry on business, or hold out or charge, as a valuer of land only while licensed.

sources.title: Land Valuers Licensing Act 1978 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person shall not carry on business, or by any means hold himself out, or demand or receive commission, reward or other valuable consideration in respect of his services, as a valuer of land unless he is licensed under this Act

sources.title: Land Valuers Licensing Act 1978 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 19, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (version of mrdoc_45309)
sources.quote: The Commissioner may grant a licence to any person who pays to the Commissioner the prescribed fee and satisfies the Commissioner, by such evidence as the Commissioner may require that he is a person of good character and repute and is competent to carry out the duties of a licensed valuer and who — [(a) deleted] (b) is a member of the Australian Property Institute;
